'''Clan Cadera''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that followed.<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
{{Quote|Clan Cadera started an uprising against Mandalore the Vindicated. Refused to side with the Sith. Refused the call by their leader. To them, it was a matter of honor. Right or wrong, they were wiped out.|[[Jekiah Ordo]]|<ref name="TOR:SoV">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>}}
When the Mandalorians under the leadership of the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], allied with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] against the Republic, Cadera clan member [[Jicoln Cadera]] spoke out against the decision. He espoused that the Mandalorians should follow the example of [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]] and support the Republic as he had done [[Galactic Standard Calendar|centuries]] ago. This conflict of ideology led to what became known as the [[Crusader's schism]],<ref name="Mandalore">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref> as Jicoln raised an [[Army/Legends|army]] of followers to oppose the ''Mand'alor''.<ref name="TOR" /> However, the movement was eventually defeated and Jicoln was largely believed to have [[Death/Legends|died]] in the aftermath,<ref name="Mandalore" /> though he had escaped into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]], in truth. Remaining members of Clan Cadera, consisted primarily of [[Gender/Legends|women]] and young [[Youngling/Legends|children]], were welcomed back into Mandalorian society.<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Torian_Cadera_survived_Vaylin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Torian Cadera, the last known survivor of his Clan]]
However, Jicoln's actions left Clan Cadera with a dishonorable stigma within the Mandalorian community. His own son, [[Torian Cadera]], was deeply ashamed of his [[Parent/Legends|father]], and was referred to by his [[Jogo|peers]] by such pejoratives as ''arue'tal'',<ref name="TOR" /> or "traitor's blood."<ref name="The Mandalorians: People and Culture">The term ''arue'tal'' is not directly defined in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''. However, the Mando'a dictionary indicates that it is likely a composite of the words ''aruetii'' and ''tal'', meaning "traitor" and "blood," respectively, in a way that indicates possession, as defined in the language section of the article ''[[The Mandalorians: People and Culture]]''.</ref> When Torian caught wind that his father was alive and living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he joined forces with the most recent [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]—a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting competition organized by the Mandalorian clans—to track down and kill Jicoln. Together with the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt|champion]], Torian engaged his disgraced father in a Mandalorian death game known as a ''[[Geroya be Haran]]'', and the two emerged victorious. However, when Jicoln recognized Torian as his estranged son, he asked for a moment alone with him to explain his actions<ref name="TOR" /> before being dealt his fate. After Jicoln had been put to rest,<ref>Jicoln's fate is determined by the player. The player's bounty hunter character can elect to encase him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] to be returned to Mandalore alive, allow Torian to kill his father, or kill Jicoln themselves. As there is currently no canonical outcome established, this article treats this event in vague terms.</ref> he was turned over to a contingent of Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to be brought to Mandalore the Vindicated. Torian, having removed the shame Clan Cadera had bore in the eyes of Mandalorian contemporaries by taking down his father, chose to join the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] crew of the Grand Champion in search of new challenges.<ref name="TOR" />

By the time of the [[war against Zakuul]], few members of the clan remained. [[Torian Cadera]] alone answered [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s call to [[Darvannis]], and became her top scout, as well as the new chief of Clan Cadera.

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Cadera first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|lore]] in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The official promotional website known as [[The Holonet]] provided further details about the clan and member Jicoln Cadera, as part of the biography of Mandalore the Vindicated.
